incidents.name: Wault Finance WUSDMaster WEX spot-price manipulation
incidents.notes: WUSDMaster.stake() and redeem() valued WEX at the manipulable WaultSwap WEX/USDT spot reserves, so a flash loan moved that price and let WUSD be minted and redeemed for far more USDT than it was backed by.

sources.ref: onchain review: WUSDMaster 0xa79Fe386B88FBee6e492EEb76Ec48517d1eC759a created 2021-08-03T09:44:23Z by 0x8beca4a43148213b57e650a24ab7562b79dd5448, unrelated to attack sender 0x886358f9296de461d12e791bc9ef6f5a03410c64; the contract was redeployed less than a day before the incident, no EIP-1967 Upgraded events, age measured from deployment. Boundary row: the victim behaved as coded and the attacker moved the WEX spot price it read. Loss converted: 390 ETH x $2,523.91 at incidentTimestamp 1628041745 (DefiLlama coingecko:ethereum) = $984,324.
